name: Strategy
summary: Clarity of position, grounded in how your audiences actually understand you.
metaDescription: Strategy from Narris International: research-informed positioning and stakeholder alignment for leaders and institutions.
lead: Strategy at Narris begins with interpretation. We study how customers, partners, investors and teams understand you, then shape a position that is clear, coherent and true to your intent.

deliverables.name: Positioning audits
deliverables.text: An account of how you are positioned today, set against how you intend to be.

deliverables.name: Stakeholder alignment reports
deliverables.text: Where each audience's understanding matches intent, and where it does not.

deliverables.name: Perception analysis
deliverables.text: How customers, partners, investors and others interpret the organisation.

deliverables.name: Audience interpretation frameworks
deliverables.text: A way to read and anticipate how audiences will understand what you say.

deliverables.name: Strategic reports and executive briefings
deliverables.text: Concise, decision-oriented documents written for senior readers.

name: Design
summary: The structure of meaning, designed so ideas are easy to follow and hard to misread.
metaDescription: Design from Narris International: narrative architecture, publication structure and positioning documents that make complex ideas clear.
lead: Design at Narris gives strategy a form people can understand. We shape the structure of meaning, from narrative frameworks to the clarity of a report, so ideas are easy to follow and hard to misread.

deliverables.name: Narrative architecture frameworks
deliverables.text: The structure of meaning behind the organisation's communication.

deliverables.name: Publication architecture
deliverables.text: The structure, sequence and format of a body of publications.

deliverables.name: Executive narrative maps
deliverables.text: A single view of how leadership explains the organisation, and to whom.

deliverables.name: Positioning documents
deliverables.text: A written statement of position that teams and partners can share.

deliverables.name: Research synthesis documents
deliverables.text: Several sources brought together into one clear, well-structured account.

name: Brand communication
summary: One voice across audiences, built on listening and shaped for each of them.
metaDescription: Brand communication from Narris International: narrative, messaging systems and executive communication strategy.
lead: We help organisations speak with one voice. Brand communication at Narris is a strategic mechanism for achieving outcomes, built on listening and shaped for each audience.

deliverables.name: Narrative architecture frameworks
deliverables.text: The structure of meaning that holds communication together.

deliverables.name: Messaging systems
deliverables.text: Core and audience-specific messages, organised for everyday use.

deliverables.name: Executive narrative maps
deliverables.text: How leadership explains the organisation, and to whom.

deliverables.name: Institutional communication strategy
deliverables.text: Direction for how the organisation communicates, and why.

deliverables.name: Communication direction for leaders
deliverables.text: Clear guidance on what to say, to whom, and why.

name: Brand-led change
summary: Clear, steady communication that carries identity and people through transition.
metaDescription: Brand-led change from Narris International: transition communication, stakeholder trust and executive counsel through institutional change.
lead: Change tests trust. We help organisations carry their identity, and their stakeholders, through transition, with communication that stays clear and steady.

deliverables.name: Transition communication frameworks
deliverables.text: A plan for what is said, to whom and when, through the period of change.

deliverables.name: Stakeholder trust strategies
deliverables.text: Approaches for sustaining or rebuilding trust with each audience.

deliverables.name: Crisis positioning guidance
deliverables.text: Direction on position and tone when circumstances are difficult.

deliverables.name: Narrative stabilisation strategies
deliverables.text: Ways to keep the organisation's story steady while conditions move.

deliverables.name: Executive strategic counsel
deliverables.text: Confidential advisory sessions, briefings and memos for the leaders carrying the change.
